statement:
∀ (N k : ℕ), Even N → 1 ≤ k →
  let m : ℕ := 2^(k+1)
  m ∣ 2*N →
    ∀ (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m), ψ.IsPrimitive →
      (∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod m)) * ψ ((N : ZMod m) - (x : ZMod m))) /
        (m.totient : ℂ) =
      if χ=ψ then if m ∣ N then ψ (-1) else -ψ (-1) else 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0014 · 在模数整除两倍目标时计算本原特征的对角符号
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0014 · Compute the primitive diagonal signs when the modulus divides twice the even target

brief.zh: 在奇单位上把反射写成乘 N−1。若模数整除 N，符号为 χ(−1)。否则要额外乘 −1。此项刻画二次幂目标的最顶层及其以下各层。
brief.en: On odd units, reflection is multiplication by N−1. The sign is χ(−1) when the modulus divides N and gains a factor −1 otherwise. This gives the top and lower layers at a power-of-two target.
